in_sanskrit.name: Mokim
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Release from bondage
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mokim एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Moksha, the state of liberation from the cycle of birth and death, achieved through self-realization and spiritual growth.

in_hindi.name: Mokim
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Release from bondage
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mokim एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Moksha, the state of liberation from the cycle of birth and death, achieved through self-realization and spiritual growth.

in_tamil.name: Mokim
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Release from bondage
in_tamil.long_meaning: Mokim ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Moksha, the state of liberation from the cycle of birth and death, achieved through self-realization and spiritual growth.

in_telugu.name: Mokim
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Release from bondage
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mokim ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Moksha, the state of liberation from the cycle of birth and death, achieved through self-realization and spiritual growth.

in_marathi.name: Mokim
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Release from bondage
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mokim हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Moksha, the state of liberation from the cycle of birth and death, achieved through self-realization and spiritual growth.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Release from bondage
